description: This file defines the Cursor struct and associated methods for traversing key/value pairs within a bucket in a BoltDB-like key-value store, including navigation, search, and deletion functionalities.

classes.name: Cursor
classes.description: An iterator for traversing key/value pairs in a bucket, supporting navigation, search, and modification.

methods.name: Bucket
methods.description: Returns the bucket from which the cursor was created.

methods.name: First
methods.description: Moves cursor to the first key/value pair in the bucket.

methods.name: Last
methods.description: Moves cursor to the last key/value pair in the bucket.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Moves cursor to the next key/value pair.

methods.name: Prev
methods.description: Moves cursor to the previous key/value pair.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Positions cursor at a specific key or the next higher key.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Internal method to position cursor at a specific key.

methods.name: goToFirstElementOnTheStack
methods.description: Positions cursor at the first leaf element in the current stack.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Positions cursor at the last leaf element in the current stack.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves cursor to the next leaf element.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves cursor to the previous leaf element.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Recursively searches for a key in the B-tree structure.

methods.name: searchNode
methods.description: Searches within a node for a key.

methods.name: searchPage
methods.description: Searches within a page for a key.

methods.name: nsearch
methods.description: Searches leaf node for a key.

methods.name: keyValue
methods.description: Returns the key and value at the current cursor position.

methods.name: node
methods.description: Returns the node at the current cursor position.
